name: Easy Eggplant, Bell Pepper & Marinara Skillet Bake with Ricotta

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, wash, dry, trim, and medium dice eggplants.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add eggplant and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until starting to brown, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tsp Italian seasoning
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add marinara sauce, bell pepper strips, cheese, and garlic to the skillet. Stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (680 g) jar marinara sauce
1 (396 g) bag frozen pepper strips
1 ½ cups shredded cheese, Italian blend
2 tsp minced garlic

instructions.primary_message: Place skillet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until warmed through and bubbling, 35-40 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to rest, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, and pick basil leaves off the stems; roll up crosswise and thinly slice into ribbons.
To serve, divide skillet bake between plates or bowls. Top with ricotta, sprinkle with basil, and enjoy!
